messages.author: Asma Abro
messages.body:
Hi everyone,
I am trying to install Amber24 following the installation guidelines in
Amber24 manual.
cd /home/xxxx
tar xvfj AmberTools24.tar.bz2
tar xvfj Amber24.tar.bz2
cd amber24_src/build
./run_cmake
make install
However, when I give the command of "make install", I get the following
error:
make: *** No rule to make target 'install'.  Stop.
I am unable to find a clue how to resolve this issue. Can someone here
please guide me what I am doing wrong?
Best Regards.
